purpose: Proposed per-target toolchain and qualification hooks. This is an inventory, not a support claim or authorization to execute generated code.

status_legend.verified_limited: Repository evidence confirms only the explicitly named limited check; this does not imply semantic, runtime, security, or model capability.
status_legend.proposed_unverified: Suggested direction only; tool versions, evaluator image digest, tests, and qualification evidence are not yet approved or proven.

common_requirements.pinning: Before qualification, select exact tool versions and immutable evaluator image digests; record OS/architecture, tool versions, dependencies, config, and hashes. Null version fields mean no version is selected.
common_requirements.execution_boundary: Execute generated code only inside an adversarially tested disposable evaluator with no host/project/credential mounts and no network egress; enforce CPU, memory, process, disk, output, and wall-clock limits and verify cleanup.
evidence: Exact tool and evaluator image versions/digests plus reproducible invocation
Parser/compiler/type-check results on representative target-specific cases
Frozen held-out tasks separated by repository/source/family, with raw per-case outcomes
For executable targets: isolated execution, expected-output/tests, timeout/resource-limit, cancellation, cleanup, and adversarial isolation results
Known limitations, unsupported syntax/version modes, and human review disposition

targets.name: Python
targets.verified_evidence: Guru evaluator invokes Python ast.parse for Python candidate contents; docs state only Python syntax is parsed. The audited host had Python 3.12.4, but this does not establish a pinned evaluator toolchain.

suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin exact CPython patch release in evaluator image; no release selected.

targets.evaluator_hook: Parse first; if executable tests are authorized, run pytest or unittest inside the disposable evaluator.
required_evidence: Python syntax cases including invalid input
Pinned interpreter and dependency lock
Isolated unit tests and no-egress/resource/cleanup evidence

targets.name: Go

suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin exact Go release and module dependency checksums; select after benchmark scope freeze.

targets.evaluator_hook: gofmt -d then go test ./... inside disposable evaluator with module/network access disabled after dependency staging.
required_evidence: Formatting/parser and compile failures
Module checksum and offline dependency policy
Isolated tests, fuzz/resource limits, no-egress proof

targets.name: C

suggested_toolchain.compiler_or_checker: Clang or GCC; standard mode must be fixed
suggested_toolchain.runtime: Native executable in disposable Linux VM/container
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Select compiler and C standard; pin compiler build, sysroot, flags, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: clang -fsyntax-only followed by isolated compile-and-test only for authorized executable tasks.
required_evidence: Pinned C language standard and compiler
Warnings/errors corpus and memory-safety instrumentation policy
Sandboxed runtime tests and adversarial isolation evidence

targets.name: C++

suggested_toolchain.compiler_or_checker: Clang or GCC with explicit -std mode
suggested_toolchain.runtime: Native executable in disposable Linux VM/container
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin compiler, C++ standard, standard library, sysroot, build flags, dependencies, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: clang++ -fsyntax-only then isolated project build/tests with network disabled.
required_evidence: Explicit C++ standard and ABI/toolchain
Compile and template-heavy representative cases
Sandboxed tests, sanitizer policy, resource and cleanup proof

targets.name: C#

suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin SDK, target framework, NuGet lock file, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: dotnet build --no-restore then dotnet test --no-build within the isolated evaluator.
required_evidence: SDK/runtime/framework and NuGet versions locked
Build/test outcomes and package provenance
Network-disabled sandbox, process/resource limits, cleanup evidence

targets.name: Rust

suggested_toolchain.parser: rustfmt parser or rustc front end
suggested_toolchain.runtime: Native executable in disposable Linux VM/container
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin rustc/cargo toolchain, target triple, Cargo.lock, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: cargo fmt --check and cargo test --locked --offline after dependencies are staged.

Compile/test outcomes including unsafe-code cases
Offline execution, resource limits, cancellation and cleanup proof

targets.name: JavaScript

suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin Node.js patch release, package manager, lockfile, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: node --check for syntax; run tests in a restricted Node process/container with network and host access denied.
required_evidence: ECMAScript/runtime mode pinned
Syntax and module-resolution cases
Isolated test, child-process, resource, timeout, and cleanup results

targets.name: TypeScript

suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin TypeScript, Node.js, tsconfig, package manager, dependency lock, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: tsc --noEmit using a locked tsconfig, then execute compiled tests in the isolated evaluator.
required_evidence: Compiler, target/lib settings, and Node versions pinned
Type-check and transpilation cases
Isolated runtime tests and no-egress/cleanup proof

targets.name: Java

suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin JDK distribution/version, language release, build tool wrapper, and dependency locks.

targets.evaluator_hook: Compile with javac --release N and run project tests inside disposable evaluator.

Compile/test outcomes
JVM process, filesystem/network, memory/time and cleanup controls

targets.name: Bash

suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin Bash and ShellCheck versions, dialect, OS base, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: bash -n and shellcheck; execute only in the isolated evaluator with minimal environment and no secrets.

Static findings and edge cases
Command-spawn, environment, filesystem/network, timeout, and cleanup tests

targets.name: POSIX shell

suggested_toolchain.parser: dash -n or another declared POSIX shell parser
suggested_toolchain.runtime: dash as selected POSIX shell implementation
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin shell implementation/version, target OS/base image, and POSIX edition.

targets.evaluator_hook: dash -n and ShellCheck --shell=sh; execute only in the isolated evaluator.
required_evidence: POSIX edition and concrete shell implementation pinned
Portability cases across declared target set
Isolated command/environment/resource/network/cleanup evidence

targets.name: PowerShell

suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin PowerShell release, .NET runtime, analyzer rules, OS image, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: ParseFile plus PSScriptAnalyzer; run tests only in a disposable restricted worker.
required_evidence: PowerShell edition/version and OS pinned
Parser/analyzer results and module lock/provenance
Constrained process, filesystem/network, timeout and cleanup evidence

targets.name: HTML

suggested_toolchain.runtime: Pinned browser engine only for behavior tests
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin checker and browser engine versions; record standard snapshot and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: Validate static documents with checker; use isolated headless browser only for explicitly scoped rendering/behavior cases.
required_evidence: Checker/browser versions and standards mode
Malformed/nested/document conformance cases
Browser isolation, network denial, resource and cleanup results for behavior tests

targets.name: XML

suggested_toolchain.parser: libxml2 xmllint with network/external entities disabled
suggested_toolchain.compiler_or_checker: xmllint --noout plus pinned schema validator where needed
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin parser/library, schema versions and resolver policy.

targets.evaluator_hook: xmllint --nonet --noout; disable DTD/external entity resolution unless a reviewed fixture explicitly requires it.
required_evidence: XML edition and parser/library version
Malformed, namespace, schema, XXE and entity-expansion test cases
Proof external resolution is disabled and resource bounds enforced

targets.name: CSS

suggested_toolchain.runtime: Pinned browser engine only for visual/behavior tests
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin parser/linter, browser engine, supported CSS feature baseline, and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: stylelint and parse checks; browser rendering only in isolated browser worker with network disabled.
required_evidence: CSS feature baseline and parser/linter versions
Parse/lint and scoped browser cases
Browser sandbox and asset/network containment evidence

targets.name: SQL

suggested_toolchain.parser: SQLGlot in explicitly selected dialect or PostgreSQL parser
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin SQL dialect, parser, database engine/version, schema fixtures and evaluator image.

targets.evaluator_hook: Parse with a dialect-explicit parser; run approved queries only against ephemeral least-privilege database with no network.
required_evidence: Dialect and engine version pinned
Schema/parameterization/query-result tests
Database isolation, destructive statement controls, resource limits, and cleanup proof

targets.name: JSON

suggested_toolchain.compiler_or_checker: JSON Schema validator only when a versioned schema is specified
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin parser and JSON Schema dialect/validator version when used.

targets.evaluator_hook: Strict parse with duplicate-key policy declared; validate schema only against a pinned schema dialect.
required_evidence: Parser/version, encoding, duplicate-key and numeric policies
Valid/invalid and size/depth cases
Schema identifier/dialect and validator digest when schema checking applies

targets.name: Git
targets.verified_evidence: Repository is a Git checkout; this proves Git is present in the workflow, not Guru's ability or authorization to perform Git operations.

suggested_toolchain.parser: git diff --check plus structured diff/status inspection
suggested_toolchain.runtime: Git CLI with isolated temporary repository fixtures
suggested_toolchain.pinning: Pin Git version and fixture image; bind commands to explicit repo root and allowed operation set.

targets.evaluator_hook: Use temporary disposable repositories for status/diff/branch/merge-conflict exercises; never commit, push, rewrite history, or touch operator repo in evaluation.
required_evidence: Git version and config baseline pinned
Fixtures for clean/dirty trees, conflicts, ignored/untracked files, and path safety
Proof all operations stay inside temp repo; explicit review/approval boundary for mutations

non_claims: No target is model-qualified by this catalog.
Python's verified_limited status refers only to AST syntax parsing in Guru's offline evaluator.
The current evaluator does not execute candidate code.
The local Python version observed in the release audit is not an approved or pinned isolated evaluator toolchain.
Git being present in the repository workflow does not grant Guru permission to commit or push.
